named_probes: Probe 1: drive each adapter with the corpus and detect execution divergence via a canary side effect (a file the injected fragment would create) rather than by reading stdout.

Probe 2 (mechanically different): capture the actual child process command line from the OS process table and compare it to the intended argv - a value that reaches the child unchanged is safe even if stdout looks odd, and a value that alters argv is unsafe even if no canary fired.
